question: As per Article 350 B of the Constitution of India, who appoints the Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**President**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Article 350 B of the Constitution of India deals with the appointment of a Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities.
 
• The Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities is appointed by the President of India.
 
• The role of the Special Officer is to investigate all matters relating to the safeguards provided for linguistic minorities under the Constitution.
 
• The Special Officer reports directly to the President on the status and issues faced by linguistic minorities in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 29 and 30**

 
 
• Article 29 provides that any section of citizens residing in the territory of India having a distinct language, script, or culture have the right to conserve the same.
 
• Article 30 grants linguistic and religious minorities the right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice.
 
 
 
• **National Commission for Minorities**
 
 
• It is a statutory body established to safeguard the rights of minorities in India.
 
• The commission addresses issues related to minority rights and welfare.
 
 
 
• **Language in the Constitution**
 
 
• Part XVII of the Constitution deals with the official language of the Republic of India.
 
• It outlines the use of Hindi and English in official government communications.
 
 
 
• **Protection of Linguistic Rights**
 
 
• Various provisions in the Constitution aim to protect the linguistic rights of minorities, ensuring they are not discriminated against based on language.
 
• These measures include education in mother tongue and the establishment of linguistic minority commissions.
